Education

Degrees

M.Sc. Research Behavioural and Social Sciences, Specialisation in Psychometrics & Statistics, University of Groningen | September 2023–July 2025, cum laude.
- Elective Courses: Structural Equation Modelling; Multilevel Analysis; Network Analysis; Statistical Modelling of Single Cases; Complexity, Dynamics and Development; Modelling Interactions of Persons and Variables over Time.
- Projects: From Problem Analysis to Intervention Design; Multidisciplinary Research in Action; Applied Statistics.
- Master Thesis: Advancing Replication Study-Decision Making with DISCOURSE: Data-Simulation via Iterative Stochastic Combinatorial Optimization Using Reported Summary Estimates.

B.Sc. Psychology, Free Choice Minor, University of Groningen | September 2020–August 2023.

B.Sc. Health Sciences, Free Choice Minor, Technical University of Munich | October 2016–August 2020.
- ERASMUS: Semester at the University of Vienna, Faculty of Psychology.

Interuniversity Graduate School of Psychometrics and Sociometrics (IOPS)

Optimization and Numerical Methods, Geert Molenberghs, Francis Tuerlinckx, Katrijn Van Deun & Tom Wilderjans, KU Leuven | 2026, December (2 ECTS)
Iterative optimization algorithms for estimating statistical model parameters, their connections to each other and to statistical inference, and related numerical methods such as numerical differentiation and integration, implemented in R.

The Use of Data in Decision-Making, Including Standardized Psychological Tests, Marieke Timmerman & Rob Meijer, University of Groningen | 2026, November (2 ECTS)
Norm- and criterion-referenced interpretation of standardized test scores, how norms are constructed and reported, and how multiple pieces of information are combined in decisions, including common flaws of holistic judgment and structured alternatives that improve decision quality.

Bayesian Item Response Theory, Jean-Paul Fox, University of Twente | 2026, October (2 ECTS)
Bayesian IRT modelling and MCMC estimation in R (JAGS, Stan), with applications to small samples and differential item functioning.

What is Psychometrics?, Dylan Molenaar (coordinator), University of Amsterdam | 2026, September (2 ECTS)
Overview of psychometrics as a research field, covering measurement in network models, response-time modelling, values in psychometrics, theory-based hypothesis evaluation with GORIC(A), Bayesian graphical modelling, and the within/between problem.

Simulation-Based Inference for Cognitive Modeling, Paul-Christian Bürkner & Stefan Radev | 2026, April (1.6 ECTS)
Hands-on introduction to simulation-based (amortized Bayesian) inference with the BayesFlow ecosystem, from simulation to model deployment.

Statistical Learning and Prediction, Tom Wilderjans & Marjolein Fokkema, Leiden University | 2026, January (2 ECTS)
Provided a comprehensive introduction to statistical learning techniques, including supervised and unsupervised methods, based on the book Introduction to Statistical Learning https://www.statlearning.com. Focused on building theoretical understanding and practical skills for applying statistical learning methods in empirical research.

Mathematics Courses

Calculus 2 (Multivariable Calculus), B.Sc. Computing Science, University of Groningen | 2026, October (5 ECTS)
Partial and directional derivatives, constrained optimization with Lagrange multipliers, multiple integrals, and Fourier series.

Linear Algebra, B.Sc. Computing Science, University of Groningen | 2026, June (5 ECTS)
Systems of linear equations, vector spaces, linear transformations, determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and orthogonality.

Teaching & Supervision Training

Start to Teach, University of Groningen | 2026, February (1.5 ECTS)
Workshop series on planning and preparing teaching activities, aligning them with learning outcomes, activating students, creating a safe learning environment, and giving feedback.

Start to Supervise, University of Groningen | 2026, February (0.4 ECTS)
Training for daily supervision of Bachelor and Master theses: the supervisor’s role, organizing the supervision process along the thesis timeline, effective communication, and formative feedback.

Seminars & Workshops

University of Groningen: Markov Chain Monte Carlo Sampling, Socio–Semantic Networks, Generative AI Workshop, Cluster Analysis and Mixture Models, Causality in Observational Data, Mixture Modelling of Longitudinal Data, Regression for Categorical Data, Thematic Analysis, and Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

Future Learn: Privacy in Research, General Data Protection Regulation, and Data Protection Agreements.

Skills

Statistical Modelling:
- Latent Variable Methods: (Non-)parametric Item Response Theory, Mokken Scaling, Response Time Models, Structural Equation Modelling.
- Supervised Methods: Regression Models (Generalized, Penalized, Spatial, Splines, GAM), Regression Trees (bagging, random forest, boosting, BART), Network Analysis.
- Unsupervised Methods: K-means, Hierarchical Clustering, Principal Components.
- Time-Series & Other Analyses: (Non-linear) Time-Series Models, Cross-Recurrence Quantification Analysis, Detrended Fluctuation Analysis.

Algorithms: Markov Chain Monte Carlo, Gibbs Sampling, Simulated Annealing, Particle Swarm Optimization, Hill Climbing.

Languages: English (C1–C2), German (Native), Dutch (A2).

Software & Services: R, GitHub, Quarto, LaTeX, SPSS, JASP.
